issues.title: [Bug] Shared WorkerHost supervision reports the broker's own state instead of the child's, and never raises a recycle election
[Bug] Source-store eviction never subtracts evicted bytes, so every later insert evicts more of the store
[Perf] FullSource promotion still sums every indexed source length on each promotion
[Bug] First-touch warm scope key ignores the KB being warmed, so a second KB is still suppressed
[Bug] Caller-site continuation is unreachable from the public tool, and a single oversized caller stalls paging forever
[Bug] inspect still reads live SDK objects on Task.Run and late sections still mutate the returned response
[Bug] STA admission byte budget ignores the payload, has no per-client bound, and the Gateway channel is still unbounded
[Bug] Log grep/since/correlation filters now only search the last N lines instead of the whole log
[Bug] SDK stall detection never fires for a call that has not emitted progress
[Perf] Lite-walk checkpoints still serialize the whole accumulated snapshot (second half of #345)
[Perf] Warm reopen still reads and decompresses every stored body to rebuild trigram postings (deferred part of #339)
[Bug] Conditional reads can return notModified from the Gateway semantic cache without the Worker checking freshness
[Bug] Multi-KB discovery loses results on a budget cut and reports paged KBs as complete
[Bug] LiteEntryAccumulator duplicate-GUID fallback leaves stale slots and can tombstone the wrong entry
[Bug] A resource-updated notification without a KB alias clears the semantic cache of every KB
Flaky test: A_Corrupted_Body_On_Disk_Is_Not_Reported_As_Certified (mtime set within the same clock tick)
[Bug] A variable of SDT, BC or built-in type cannot be marked as a collection: modify reports 'Domain ... was not found'
[Bug] Build diagnostics: dropped severity loses compiler errors, and the [generate-gap] warning is false for Main procedures
[Bug] genexus_edit part=Variables mode=patch reports WriteNotPersisted when the lines were written at another index
[Bug] release-preflight.ps1 crashes in Add-PreflightPhaseResult, aborting the release after the long phases
